name: Sikagard-706 Thixo
paste:
SIKAGARD®-706 THIXO: SPECIFICATION CLAUSE SET

Source: Sikagard®-706 Thixo, April 2023, Version 02.01 (https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/p/sikagard_-706_thixo.pdf)
Draft for specifier review. Wording, values and standards are quoted from that data sheet; where it is silent the clause says 'Refer to manufacturer.' Confirm the current edition before issue.

1 SCOPE
1.1 Work included. Provide Sikagard®-706 Thixo where documented, installed or applied in accordance with this clause and the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (April 2023, Version 02.01).
1.2 Product description.
    - Sikagard®-706 Thixo is a one-component reactive silane based impregnation cream.
    - It is a solvent free product with ~ 80% content of active substance. Sikagard®-706 Thixo complies with the highest requirements of EN 1504-2 for hydrophobic Impregnation (penetration depth class II & resistance to freeze and thaw salt stresses).
1.3 Intended uses stated by the manufacturer. Sikagard®-706 Thixo is used as water-repellent impregnation (hydrophobic treatment) for absorbent substrates such as concrete in civil engineering or building concrete structures subjected to heavy stress due to freeze and thaw cycles and de-icing salts or chloride attack in marine environment
    - Suitable for protection against ingress (Principle 1, method 1.1 of EN 1504-9)
    - Suitable for moisture control (Principle 2, method 2.1 of EN 1504-9)
    - Suitable for increasing the resistivity (Principle 8, method 8.1 of EN 1504-9)
1.4 Limits of use. Observe the manufacturer's limitations stated in clause 4.7.

2 MATERIALS
2.1 Product. Sikagard®-706 Thixo
    - Product type as printed on the data sheet: Sikagard-706 Thixo is a one part reactive silane based impregnation cream. It is a solvent free product with ~ 80% content of active substance. Sikagard-706 Thixo complies with the highest requirements of EN 1504-2 for hydrophobic Impregnation (penetration depth class II & resistance to freeze and thaw salt stresses).
    - Supplier as printed on the data sheet: Sika Australia Pty Limited, ABN 12 001 342 329, aus.sika.com, Tel: 1300 22 33 48
2.2 Approvals / certificates.
    - Conforms to the requirements of LPM-qualification test to SIA 162/5, Report A-20 450-1 of 19.04.1999. (Water absorption, penetration depth, alkali resistance, water vapour diffusion, resistance to freeze thaw cycles and de-icing salts).
    - Conforms to the requirement of the “Bro 2002” Swedish National Road Administration (SNRA) publication No. VV2002:47 –report reference F507580 Arev
    - Conforms to the requirements of the EN 1504-2 class II – Polymer Institute report P 5672-E dated 9th August 2007.
    - Hydrophobic impregnation according to EN 1504-2, DoP 02 03 03 01 002 0 000003 1105; certified by Factory Production Control Body: 0921; certificate 0921-BPR-2050 and provided with the CE-mark
2.3 Standards and test methods cited in the data sheet. Cited as written in the data sheet. A citation is not a statement that the product complies with it; conformity is stated only where the data sheet says so (see the approvals clause and the statements quoted in the other clauses).
    - EN 1504-2: cited elsewhere in the data sheet; listed under approvals, certificates or standards; test method printed beside a stated value. Where: Approvals / Certificates (p.1); Description (p.1); Technical Information > Penetration depth (p.2).
    - EN 1504-9: cited elsewhere in the data sheet. Where: Uses (p.1).
    - ASTM D 3960: test method printed beside a stated value. Where: Product Information > Volatile organic compound (VOC) content (p.2).
    - EN 13580: test method printed beside a stated value. Where: Product Information > Water absorption (p.2); Technical Information > Resistance to alkalinity (p.2).
    - EN 13579: test method printed beside a stated value. Where: Technical Information > Drying rate coefficient (p.2).
    - EN 13581: test method printed beside a stated value. Where: Technical Information > Freeze thaw de-icing salt resistance (p.2).
2.4 Characteristics stated by the manufacturer.
    - Non-sag (thixotropic) consistency, allowing wastage-free application of sufficient quantities and assuring deep penetration
    - Reduction of water absorption
    - Reduction of absorption of aggressive or deleterious agents dissolved in water (i.e. de-icing salts or chloride from marine environment)
    - No noticeable change of water vapour permeability
    - Not film forming
    - Ready for use
    - Long term efficiency, deep penetration
    - Increases the resistance of concrete to freeze and thaw cycles and de-icing salts
    - Resistant to sea water
    - Low VOC content
2.5 Composition, appearance and supply.
    - Composition: Silane
    - Appearance and colour: White paste / cream (transparent after application and drying)
    - Density: ~ 0.900 kg/l (at +20 °C)
    - Volatile organic compound (VOC) content: ~319 g/l (ASTM D 3960)
2.6 Properties stated by the manufacturer.
    - Active content: ~ 80%
    - Water absorption: < 7.5% (EN 13580)
    - Resistance to alkalinity: < 10% (EN 13580)
    - Freeze thaw de-icing salt resistance: Comply (EN 13581)
2.7 Penetration depth.
    | ≥ 10 mm | Class II |
    Note: Test performed on concrete with W/C 0.70
    Test method printed: (EN 1504-2)
2.8 Drying rate coefficient.
    | Class I: | >30% |
    Test method printed: (EN 13579)
2.9 System structure. 1–2 coats of Sikagard®-706 Thixo
2.10 Packaging, shelf life and storage.
    - Packaging: 18 kg and 180 kg containers
    - Shelf life: 12 months from date of production if stored in unopened, undamaged and original sealed packaging.
    - Storage conditions: Store in dry and cool conditions. Protect from moisture.

3 SUBSTRATE PREPARATION
3.1 General. Prepare substrates in accordance with the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (April 2023, Version 02.01) and the requirements below. Inspect the substrate against these requirements before application.
3.2 Substrate quality / pre-treatment.
    - Free of dust, dirt, oil, efflorescence and existing paint coats.
    - Cracks in concrete more than 300 μm must be repaired prior to application of the hydrophobic treatment.
    - Cleaning is best done with suitable detergents or by light blastcleaning, steam cleaning etc.
    - Best results are obtained on dry, very absorbent substrates. The substrate must look dry with no damp patches.

4 APPLICATION
4.1 General. Apply in accordance with the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (April 2023, Version 02.01) and the requirements below.
4.2 Consumption. Dependent on substrate profile and porosity as well as the required penetration depth: ~ 200–300 g/m² per coat. Normally, 1 coat is enough – preliminary trial shall be carried out to assess the penetration depth in the substrate.
4.3 Waiting time to overcoating. Can be overcoated with water and solvent based polymer paint - contact the proposed paint manufacturer for recommendations. Sikagard®-706 Thixo can be used as water repellent primer under many Sikagard® protective coatings. Penetration of water is thus prevented at possible weak spots or in the event of damage to the top coat and the risk of consequential damages such as paint flaking can be reduced. Waiting time: minimum 5 hours, maximum 1 week.
4.4 Mixing. Sikagard®-706 Thixo is supplied ready for use and should not be thinned or diluted.
4.5 Application. Sikagard®-706 Thixo is applied using airless spray, brush or long-hair roller (including automatically feed roller).
4.6 Cleaning of equipment. Clean all tools and application equipment with Colma Cleaner immediately after use. Hardened / cured material can only be mechanically removed.
4.7 Limitations and important considerations.
    - Best results are achieved when Sikagard®-706 Thixo is applied on 28 days old concrete – however, due to its high alkali resistance, it is still possible to apply it at a very early age.
    - Areas such as window frames which still need to be painted must be securely covered to avoid contact with Sikagard®-706 Thixo.
    - Areas not to be impregnated such as window panes need to be protected from being accidentally contaminated with Sikagard®-706 Thixo.
    - Sikagard®-706 Thixo can damage some coatings and bituminous products.
    - Sikagard®-706 Thixo can lead to darkening of concrete, apply sample areas first.
    - Cannot be overcoated with limewash or cement paint.
    - Apply Sikagard®-706 Thixo onto a sample area to confirm consumption rates versus required penetration depth.
    - Refer to the latest Method Statement for detailed information regarding surface preparation, application method, etc.

5 QUALITY CONTROL AND TESTING
5.1 Hold point. Before each application, measure and record the conditions in clause 5.2 and compare them with the manufacturer's limits. HOLD POINT: do not proceed until the Superintendent has released the hold point.
5.2 Ambient air temperature. +5 °C min. / +40 °C max.
5.3 Substrate temperature. +5 °C min. / +35 °C max.
5.4 Substrate moisture content. <5-6% when measured with Tramex method
5.5 Trials, test areas and compatibility checks stated by the manufacturer.
    - Normally, 1 coat is enough – preliminary trial shall be carried out to assess the penetration depth in the substrate.
    - Apply Sikagard®-706 Thixo onto a sample area to confirm consumption rates versus required penetration depth.
5.6 Test methods printed beside stated values. Each value is as printed in the data sheet with its test method.
    - Volatile organic compound (VOC) content: ~319 g/l (ASTM D 3960)
    - Water absorption: < 7.5% (EN 13580)
    - Penetration depth: ≥ 10 mm | Class II; Note: Test performed on concrete with W/C 0.70 (EN 1504-2)
    - Drying rate coefficient: Class I: | >30% (EN 13579)
    - Resistance to alkalinity: < 10% (EN 13580)
    - Freeze thaw de-icing salt resistance: Comply (EN 13581)
5.7 Basis of the stated values. All technical data stated in this Product Data Sheet are based on laboratory tests. Actual measured data may vary due to circumstances beyond our control.
5.8 Other tests. For any test method, sampling frequency or acceptance criterion not stated in this clause: refer to manufacturer and the project specification.

6 WARRANTY AND DOCUMENTATION
6.1 Documents to be obtained and submitted. Obtain the current issue of each document before ordering and submit it with the product submission. Documents are listed as published on the manufacturer's website.
    - Product Data Sheet: Sikagard®-706 Thixo, April 2023, Version 02.01, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/p/sikagard_-706_thixo.pdf
    - Safety Data Sheet: SDS Sikagard®-706 Thixo, version 16/11/2025, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/2/sds-sikagard-706thixo.pdf
6.2 Ecology, health and safety. For information and advice on the safe handling, storage and disposal of chemical products, users shall refer to the most recent Safety Data Sheet (SDS) containing physical, ecological, toxicological and other safety-related data.
6.3 Warranty. Obtain any product or installation warranty in writing from the manufacturer or its authorised applicator and file it with the project records. Warranty terms: refer to manufacturer.
    - Legal notes: In practice, the differences in materials, substrates and actual site conditions are such that no warranty in respect of merchantability or of fitness for a particular purpose, nor any liability arising out of any legal relationship whatsoever, can be inferred either from this information, or from any written recommendations, or from any other advice offered.
6.4 Local restrictions. Please note that as a result of specific local regulations the declared data for this product may vary from country to country. Please consult the local Product Data Sheet for the exact product data.
6.5 Application records. Record the product name, batch numbers, dates, areas treated and the conditions measured under clause 5.2, and include the records in the project documentation.
